text: The controller assigns currentView.reset() to isClean and immediately tests its truthiness before hiding views and clearing currentView. Both concrete email and address-book reset methods are async and await subview initialization before finishing cleanup and returning true. Their immediate return is a Promise. This guard therefore does not represent completed cleanup or observe the eventual result/rejection. The mismatch is present in the owned and fixed accepted phases; no new regression, reproduced close failure or runtime effect is claimed.
title: Account Hub's synchronous reset guard does not await its async view resets
